pieces.text: is a holiday in Mexico. Its name means "Day of the Dead." It is a happy holiday to remember friends and family who have died. People believe the spirits of their loved ones come back to visit on Día de los Muertos.
To get ready for the spirits, people decorate graves. A

is a place where a dead person is buried. On Día de los Muertos, people clean the graves. They bring candles and flowers to make the graves beautiful. They bring food to the graves to have a party. Some people stay all night to visit with the spirits of the dead.

paragraphs.text: Día de los Muertos happens on November 1st and 2nd. It is close to another holiday called Halloween. But it is not the same. On Día de los Muertos, the spirits of the dead are not scary. The spirits come back to celebrate with the people they love.

content.text: During Kwanzaa, younger family members spend time with and learn from older family members.

pieces.text: is a holiday about African American history. It is a time for African American people to think about their communities and their ancestors.
are family members who lived long ago.
In the past, many African people were taken to the United States as enslaved people.
means being owned by someone else and forced to work. Family members could even be sold and taken away from each other.
It was hard for enslaved people to spend holidays together. They were not allowed to celebrate the way they did in Africa. Many of their traditions were lost.
are special things people have done for many years.

Dr. King saw that people were treated unfairly because of the color of their skin. Many places were segregated.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people couldn't go to the same schools as white people. They had to sit at the back of the bus. And they weren't allowed to go to many of the places like restaurants, swimming pools, and hotels that white people went to.
Dr. King wanted this to change. He became a leader in the
. This movement was a group of thousands of Black and white people. They thought that everyone should be treated fairly.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people couldn't go to the same schools as white people. They had to sit at the back of the bus. And they weren't allowed to go to many of the places like restaurants, swimming pools, and hotels that white people went to.
Dr. King wanted this to change. He became a leader in the
. This movement was a group of thousands of Black and white people. They thought that everyone should be treated fairly.

paragraphs.text: Memorial Day is a holiday in America. It happens on the last Monday in May. Memorial Day is about celebrating American soldiers. These soldiers help to keep the United States safe. But sometimes, soldiers die protecting our country. Memorial Day is a time to remember the soldiers who died.

pieces.text: The United States did not always celebrate Memorial Day. The holiday began more than 150 years ago. It started after the Civil War. In this war, Americans fought against each other. Many soldiers died. After the war, people wanted a way to honor the dead soldiers.
the soldiers means remembering them and showing respect for them.

paragraphs.text: After the Civil War, Americans picked a day in May. They spent it honoring soldiers who died in the Civil War. Later, Americans kept celebrating the holiday to honor soldiers who died in other wars. Today, we call this holiday "Memorial Day."

paragraphs.text: Every year, there is a holiday to celebrate presidents. It is called Presidents' Day. It is celebrated on the third Monday in February.
The president is the leader of the United States. The president helps make choices for the country. The president also works with the leaders of other countries.

Today, people celebrate Presidents' Day in different ways. Because Presidents' Day is a holiday, many students do not have to go to school. Some adults do not have to go to work. Instead, people might go to a parade with friends and family. Or they might visit a place that celebrates a president.

paragraphs.text: People in the United States celebrate Thanksgiving in the fall. It happens on a Thursday in November. On Thanksgiving, people give thanks for all the good things in their lives.

The first Thanksgiving happened long ago. There were two groups of people who started out as strangers. Long before the United States became a country, Native American groups were already there. They had been there for many years. One of these groups is called the Wampanoag. The Wampanoag fed themselves by farming and fishing. They built many towns where hundreds of people lived together.
